subject: english
title: Unit 2: Space Exploration & Hobbies
subTitle: Lessons 2.4 - 2.5: Present Simple, Both/But/Too & Adverbs of frequency

cards.vietnamese: Tàu con thoi (tàu vũ trụ có thể tái sử dụng)
cards.definition: A spacecraft designed to transport people and cargo between Earth and space.
cards.example: Astronauts travelled to the space station in a space shuttle.

cards.vietnamese: Xe thám hiểm tự hành trên các hành tinh khác
cards.definition: A vehicle used for exploring the surface of an extraterrestrial planet.
cards.example: The Curiosity rover is exploring the rocky surface of Mars.

cards.vietnamese: Vệ tinh nhân tạo bay quanh Trái Đất
cards.definition: An artificial body placed in orbit around the earth or moon to collect information.
cards.example: Satellites send television signals and weather data to Earth.

cards.vietnamese: Thì hiện tại đơn diễn tả sự thật hiển nhiên hoặc thói quen hàng ngày
cards.definition: Used to describe general truths, facts, or regular habits.
cards.example: The Earth moves around the Sun. He washes his bike every day.

cards.vietnamese: Both: cả hai. But: nhưng (nêu sự đối lập). Too: cũng (cuối câu khẳng định)
cards.definition: Conjunctions used to connect ideas, show contrast, or add similar information.
cards.example: We both like space. My cousin has a cat, but I haven't. I have a dog too.

cards.vietnamese: Trạng từ chỉ tần suất: Always (100%), Usually (90%), Often (70%), Never (0%)
cards.definition: Words that describe how often an action happens.
cards.example: She often plays the violin in her free time.

cards.definition: To play music on a string instrument using a bow.
cards.example: What do you like doing in your free time? - I like playing the violin.

exercises.question: What is an artificial vehicle sent to explore the surface of Mars called?
exercises.explanation: Rover là xe tự hành thám hiểm bề mặt các hành tinh.

exercises.question: He ________ his hands carefully before dinner every evening.
exercises.explanation: Chủ ngữ số ít 'He' ở hiện tại đơn thêm -es: washes.

exercises.question: My sister likes orange juice, ________ I prefer fresh milk.
exercises.explanation: Dùng 'but' (nhưng) để nối hai mệnh đề thể hiện sự đối lập.

exercises.question: Which adverb of frequency means doing something 100% of the time?
exercises.explanation: Always có nghĩa là luôn luôn (100% tần suất).

exercises.question: What do you do at the weekend? — I ________ the flowers in the garden.
exercises.explanation: Water the flowers nghĩa là tưới hoa cho vườn.
